name: Don't Start the Murmur
description: The premise of the series revolves around the daily lives of different couples of all ages from 20 to 65, but who are not connected to each other. Each couple has their own space where they live, while the story of each couple in each episode is not connected to the stories of the other couples.

videos.title: Make the Bad Things Good
videos.overview: Charlie becomes jealous when Pierce and Malcolm are paired up in a class project. He tries to drive a wedge between them by turning Malcolm evil using Helsing's magic music player.
